channel.title: Adjona Insights
channel.description: Practical insights on Microsoft 365 security, governance, data protection, automation and AI readiness for charities, care providers, CICs and smaller organisations.

item.title: Cybersecurity is slipping down the agenda for small charities
item.description: 60% of charities now rate cybersecurity a high priority, down from 68% last year. Five proportionate controls every small charity should have in place, and a free governance review offer for five qualifying charities.

item.title: CQC is changing how it assesses care providers: is your evidence ready?
item.description: CQC is developing new sector-specific assessment frameworks. What care providers should do now to improve policy control, evidence registers and governance using Microsoft 365.

item.title: The September 2026 DBS change: what charities using volunteers need to do now
item.description: From 1 September 2026, the DBS supervision exemption is removed. What charities, community groups and sports clubs using volunteers need to review before the deadline.

item.title: The EU's AI transparency rules now apply: what UK organisations should do
item.description: From 2 August 2026, EU AI Act transparency provisions began to apply. Practical steps UK charities, SMEs and service providers should take when using generative AI.

item.title: Free Webinar: Who Still Has Access? Managing Leavers and Microsoft 365 Access — 16 September 2026
item.description: Free online briefing for charities, care providers and SMEs on managing leavers and Microsoft 365 access. Wednesday 16 September 2026, 12:30–1:15 PM BST.

item.title: What the 2026 Equality Act Code of Practice means for charity governance
item.description: The Equality Act 2010 Code of Practice came into force on 5 August 2026. It creates no new legal duties, but carries statutory evidential weight.

item.title: When a critical supplier goes offline: a charity's guide to operational resilience
item.description: The temporary suspension of CAF Bank's online banking service is a reminder that operational resilience extends beyond your own systems. A practical guide for trustees and charity leaders.

item.title: AI may not take your job. Refusing to adapt could.
item.description: AI does not usually erase whole occupations in one clean sweep. It changes which parts of a job are valuable. Lessons from the typewriter, the calculator and the spreadsheet for organisations adopting AI and Copilot today.

item.title: Phishing has moved beyond email: is your Microsoft 365 environment ready?
item.description: Phishing now extends beyond email to Microsoft Teams, identity attacks and malicious applications. Here is what every organisation should review in their Microsoft 365 environment.

item.title: The Microsoft 365 operational resilience blueprint
item.description: A practical four-phase roadmap from secure foundations to structural clarity, governed automation and AI readiness.

item.title: Trustee confidence is high, but important governance gaps remain
item.description: What the Charity Commission's Research with trustees: 2026 reveals about trustee confidence, financial controls, governance knowledge and technology adoption.

item.title: Why your organic Microsoft 365 setup is a hidden risk
item.description: Why gradual Microsoft 365 adoption can create hidden risks involving permissions, information governance, email security, automation and AI readiness.

item.title: Can your care service find and protect the records, emails and evidence it relies on?
item.description: How care providers can organise and protect records, emails, documents and compliance evidence held across Microsoft 365 and other systems.

item.title: Fixing messy Teams, SharePoint and file access in Microsoft 365
item.description: How to review and improve Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, file structures, external sharing and user permissions.
